exposure: Women with hematomas at the attachment zone of the LAM to the pubic bone
Women with hematomas away from the attachment zone of the LAM to the pubic bone
Presence of hematoma at the site of LAM attachment to the pubic bone
finding: Hematoma at the site of LAM attachment to the pubic bone was significantly associated with LAM avulsion diagnosed at 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: This study found that hematomas at the site of LAM attachment from vaginal deliveries always resulted in avulsion diagnosed at 3 months postpartum, while cesarean sections were only mentioned in one case of hematoma.
